subject: CRM plan review: Day 7 still incomplete
body: Reviewed namnx-vn/crm-demo current master. Core concepts/demos are largely present, but the main Day 7 CRM integration is not complete. Remaining primary-route work: /customers search + pagination backed by URL searchParams, query keys containing search/page, empty state and route loading/error boundaries; /customers/[id] integrated edit form + mutation + relevant cache refresh. Zustand selection is integrated and customer detail links work. Next session should implement Day 7 before marking the overall plan done.
